# HANA SCENT ARTIST

HANA SCENT ARTIST is a Taiwan-based olfactory art and creative development practice founded by Hana 沈秉儀.

## Founder
Hana 沈秉儀
Role: Olfactory Artist · Perfumer · Creative Mentor
Chinese role: 嗅覺藝術家・調香師・創作育成陪伴者

## Primary focus
HANA SCENT ARTIST currently focuses on two primary service areas:
1. 藝術育成 (Art Incubation / Creative Mentoring)
2. 品牌合作 (Brand Collaboration / Scent Branding)

Professional perfumery and olfactory art form the creative and technical foundation of these services.

## Core services

### 藝術育成
https://hanascent.com/incubation/
Supports creators from creative direction and identity through early-stage operations, commercialization, fragrance product development, PIF coordination, and implementation.

### 品牌合作
https://hanascent.com/business/
Brand scent identity, sensory design, space scent design, fragrance product development, and brand or corporate collaboration.

### 香氛產品開發
https://hanascent.com/product-development/
Fragrance concept development, formulation, sampling, packaging and manufacturing coordination, OEM/ODM coordination, documentation, and product realization.

### PIF 化粧品產品資訊檔案
https://hanascent.com/pif/
PIF document review, gap identification, information organization, testing coordination, and safety assessment workflow collaboration. Qualified professionals perform work that legally requires qualified safety assessment or signing.

### 專業調香
https://hanascent.com/overture-series/
Professional perfumery education and olfactory training, including the 氣味藝術序曲 series.

### 此域 HINENI
https://hanascent.com/ciyu/
HANA SCENT ARTIST's olfactory narrative and creative space at Beitou Heart Village in Taipei.

## Key concepts
藝術育成, 創作者育成, Creative Mentor, 品牌合作, 品牌氣味識別, 香氛產品開發, PIF, 嗅覺藝術, 專業調香, 感官敘事, Olfactory Artist, Perfumer
